name: klar-hotel-engine

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.//build:assets: tsc emits .ts only, so the migration SQL never reached dist and RUN_MIGRATIONS=true died on ENOENT. migrate.ts resolves them via import.meta.url, so they must sit BESIDE the compiled migrate.js, not at a path of their own. fs.cpSync keeps this dependency-free and works on every platform.

//dependencies: pg and ioredis are dependencies of the DEPLOYABLE only. The engine and its test suite build and run without either; src/main.ts imports each dynamically and fails loudly at boot if REDIS_URL/DATABASE_URL is set but the driver is missing.
